{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-low-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u010/system/state/workspace/programs/task-aa366120.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Copy the non-background pattern into the zero panel, reflected left-to-right.
    bg = grid[0][0]
    source_rows = [r for r in range(len(grid)) if any(v not in (bg, 0) for v in grid[r])]
    source_cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c] not in (bg, 0) for r in range(len(grid)))]
    panel = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 0]
    if not source_rows or not source_cols or not panel:
        return out
    pr = sorted({r for r, c in panel})
    pc = sorted({c for r, c in panel})
    for i, r in enumerate(pr):
        for j, c in enumerate(pc):
            sr, sc = source_rows[i], source_cols[len(source_cols) - 1 - j]
            out[r][c] = grid[sr][sc]
    return out
"
}
